narrative.overview: BuzzRouter is a quiet, information-dense discovery tool. It feels closer to Linear or GitHub than to a marketing site: flat working surfaces, compact controls, clear selection, and factual copy. The first viewport is the real directory, not a hero or feature explanation. The public directory is the canonical visual source; new public work should converge toward it rather than extend older auxiliary-route variants.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-gray canvas around flat white working planes.
One compact Instrument Sans voice with zero letter spacing.
Indigo reserved for selection, navigation, links, and primary actions.
Emerald reserved for explicit verified and success states.
One-line community purpose and category visible in result rows.
First-party logos with deterministic monogram fallbacks.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo identifies interaction and selection; it is not general decoration.

rules.name: The Written Status Rule
rules.body: Semantic color supplements plain-language status and never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing is zero across the system.

rules.name: The Context Stays Visible Rule
rules.body: Wide screens pair results with a sticky detail inspector; narrow screens stack them.

rules.name: The Real Product First Rule
rules.body: The directory and current data occupy the first screen; there is no marketing hero.

rules.name: The Flat Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Lists, inspectors, command bars, fields, and form panels stay shadowless.

dos: Do show a one-line purpose and useful category directly in result rows.
Do keep search focused on names, descriptions, and category tags.
Do use first-party cached relay logos with monogram fallbacks.
Do keep trust evidence separate from future popularity signals.
Do preserve flat planes, tight radii, crisp dividers, and compact controls.
Do pair semantic colors with explicit written status.
donts: Don't add ratings or popularity labels before credible telemetry exists.
Don't add a Verification route or promotional verification section.
Don't use relay hosts as the primary public search or row description.
Don't reintroduce the unshipped animated premise or decorative textures.
Don't turn sections into floating rounded cards or nest cards.
Don't add gradients, dark-neon crypto styling, glass, or marketing heroes.
